newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Advance half-yr net rises 12.48 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Advance half-yr net rises 12.48 pct.

text.p: Advance Bank Australia Ltd, which is now wholly owned by St George Bank Ltd, reported on Wednesday a 12.48 percent rise in net profit after abnormals to A$90.10 million in the six months ended November 30, 1996.
Advance said operating profit before abnormal items and tax rose 12.03 percent to A$145.41 million in the half year.
It said interest revenue rose 3.69 percent to A$907.68 million and interest expense rose 2.98 percent to A$601.41 million in the half year.
The Sydney-based bank increased its half year dividend to 20 cents a share from 17.5 cents a year earlier.

Bad debt expense fell 61.59 percent to A$2.96 million, Advance said. St George formally took over Advance today after a scrip and cash offer which valued Advance at about A$2.65 billion. St George shares ended five cents lower at A$7.82.
